nodes.name: Patient-2
nodes.summary:
Patient-2, born on 05.09.1955 with case number URO-2026-0002, was referred by Dr. med. Arzt-1 from the Urologische Klinik at Klinikum Berlin for specialist presentation and further urological workup due to nykturie, pollakisurie, and an elevated PSA level. Patient-2 underwent laboratory testing on 16 November 2026, showing a total PSA level of 20,0 ng/ml. On 3 December 2026, prostate biopsies confirmed an adenocarcinoma of the prostate (C61 Prostatakarzinom) with a Gleason score of 4+4=8 (ISUP 4). On 15 December 2026, a CT scan showed no distant metastases and negative lymph nodes. On 28 December 2026, the interdisciplinary tumor board recommended primary androgen deprivation therapy (ADT). Treatment with Leuprorelin and Bicalutamid was initiated in January 2027. Patient-2 has a clinical diagnosis of locally advanced prostate adenocarcinoma treated with primary hormone therapy (ADT), maintaining a good general condition with an ECOG performance status of 0.

nodes.name: Prostatakarzinom
